description: Two modules export a function of the same name; only one of them is imported anywhere. An agent that edits by name instead of by who calls what changes the wrong file and leaves the tests red.

criteria: Thousands are grouped in the money formatter that the receipt printer actually imports (src/format.js). The superseded src/format_old.js, which declares a function of the same name and is required by nothing, is left untouched, and the test suite passes.
